content.title: Meaning of the name San Jose
content.text: Introduction Family Hinduism Buddhism Jainism Christianity See also Background, origin and meaning of San Jose: The name "San Jose" is of Spanish origin, meaning "Saint Joseph" in English. It is a common toponym in Spanish-speaking regions, often used to honor Saint Joseph, the husband of Mary and the earthly father of Jesus in Christian tradition. The name reflects the strong Catholic influence in the history and culture of these areas. Derivable or associated names include Jose, Joseph, and Josefina. Many cities and towns bear this name, but one of the most well-known is San Jose, California. Founded in 1777, it was California's first civilian settlement and served as its first state capital. Today, San Jose is a major technology hub and the largest city in the Silicon Valley. Other notable "San Jose" places include San Jose, Costa Rica, the nation's capital and largest city, known for its cultural attractions and historical landmarks, and San Jose, Uruguay, a city with a rich agricultural history.
